runtime: Standalone Luau; cached live client when accessible, independent multiplayer snapshot observer otherwise

verification.independent_multiplayer_mirror_parity: Offline synthetic packets: ownership, flags, owner stats, structures, attacks and four construction prices match uploaded GameState/Rules
verification.naval_and_diplomacy_contracts: Offline parity with supplied original Protocol, WorldMap, GameState and Rules: boat/build-warship/move/ally-request/ally-break encoding; water connectivity, unit paths/health, traitor flags and warship prices
verification.recruitment_optimum: Computed continuous optimum compared against original Rules.troop_growth for human armies over 1001 bank levels at capacities 1000, 10000, 100000 and 1000000; all passed
verification.nuclear_module_parity: Original supplied Protocol/GameState/Rules: SAM/silo/all three launch encodings; missile rows, shot stamps, global MIRV escalation and five prices; 97 curved trajectory points; carrier and warhead intercept flags. Passed.
verification.country_counterattack_parity: 18 cases matched original supplied SimAI._defend amount and thresholds
verification.development_simulator_comparison: benchmarks/strategy_v1.5.json; four paired 180-second engineering worlds vs built-in country/tribe AI; no human win-rate claim
verification.core_simulator_smoke: Three-minute synthetic flat/coastal engineering world with original supplied Sim, six country AI starts and twelve tribes, seed 1: survived, 4964 land cells, 623091 home troops, 55 orders and 3 owned buildings. Not human-opponent validation.
verification.income_recovery_simulator_smoke: v1.7 survived the same three-minute country/tribe engineering world: 4964 land, 623091 home troops, 55 orders, 3 owned buildings. This world did not exercise human betrayal or establish an income/win-rate gain.
verification.renewal_parity: Original Protocol ally_extend encoding and GameState alliance expiry, window, two-party request bits and eligibility matched synthetic mirror observations.
verification.diplomacy_simulator_smoke: Three-minute original country/tribe engineering world: survived, 4005 land, 1266372 home troops, 84450 gold, 51 orders, 4 buildings. No human win-rate or emergency survival claim.
verification.adaptation_simulator_smoke: Original three-minute country/tribe engineering world: alive, 4005 land, 1266372 home troops, 84450 gold, 51 orders, 4 buildings. Same result as preceding smoke; no competitive gain established.
verification.planning_engineering_comparison: benchmarks/planning_v2.0.json: four paired 180s and 540s synthetic original-simulator country/tribe worlds vs v1.9. All survived. New land lower in three of four 180s seeds; higher in three of four 540s seeds, with higher mean building count. Development seeds; not held-out human strength evaluation.
verification.atlas_microbenchmark: Two-million-cell map / 100K owned cells: 129 bounded scan updates, median 1.05ms, p95 6.61ms, max 14.69ms on development host; excludes other bot work.
verification.donation_protocol_parity: Donation intent encoding matched supplied original Protocol. Existing renewal and nuclear contracts still passed.
verification.conquest_gold_parity: Original Rules.conquer_gold(0,gold) matched full current treasury at 0, 1, 50000 and 1500000.
verification.conquest_smoke: Two 180-second original country/tribe simulator seeds survived, land 3161 and 4346 vs v2.1 land 3330 and 3246. Mixed engineering outcomes, not a test of human strength or credited elimination speed.

network_fallback_scope: Multiplayer spawning, land combat/expansion/recall, diplomacy, city/factory/port/defense/SAM/silo, transports, warship construction/patrol, atom/hydrogen/MIRV launch, nuclear reload and fallout observations
strategy: Board-level reserves/recovery, separate human/country/tribe treatment, paced raids, diplomacy stand-down, profitable asset capture/reassessment, neutral-growth comparison, human-density/coast/encirclement spawn scoring; existing nuclear/naval safeguards retained; stable home/economic core, locally prioritized buffer clearance, core threat reserves and recalls, core construction and naval patrol priorities; production-link placement and fleet savings, explicit alliance-break attribution/quarantine, diplomatic backoff, bounded neutral relocation when stranded; scored acceptance/offers/renewals with reasons, country grace treated as uncertain, dominance and naval coercion risk, emergency-first recalls/peace/affordable missiles/limited survival boats, countdown spawn reassessment and bounded faster polling; emergency post count and rolling purchase budget, quiet-core SAM savings, constrained human naval raids and safe neutral relocation despite residual frontier samples; incremental frozen ownership atlas and adjacency, explicit defend/invest/expand/negotiate/relocate alternatives with bounded quiet-guard expansion, marginal investment and exposure ranking with level-based production targets, named enemy campaign objectives/budgets/deadlines/consolidation/exits, persistent bounded display-name opponent evidence and lasting betrayal penalties
match_report: Local RoWorld_Match_Report.json with last 64 orders and target IDs/kinds, board/candidates/spawn assessment, five-second timeline up to 120 samples, plus prior nuclear/fallout metrics; no automatic upload; strategy.core center/home ownership, anchors, estimated building importance, up to 32 core building locations, sampled local ownership and land/naval threats; alliance end history with confirmation/reason, advertised income and production/traffic/reserve diagnostics; diplomacy candidates/reasons and nominal cadence limits, emergency action availability reason; bounded public player summaries, opening/recent leader snapshots and observed attack/structure/missile events, runtime timings and blocked reason, manual export and timestamped archives; atlas age/components/public adjacency, planner alternatives/actions/reasons, ranked investment assumptions, active and recent campaign records, opponent assessments and profile storage diagnostics
arsenal_limitations: Artillery, airfields, railguns, mega/scatter and reinforce are not automated; no account item purchases or unlocks
profile_storage: Local RoWorld_Opponent_Profiles.json when file functions work, otherwise memory; 128 records with eviction, validated bounded JSON loading, ambiguous display-name matching with limited cross-match penalty; no automatic upload
cooperation: Any positive team IDs and snapshot team names; optional live Roblox friendship lookup, cached per UserId with unique display-name nation binding, duplicates skipped and opposing-team friends excluded; alliance priority and attack/blast protection, existing land recall, limited actual-allied troop support with reserve and send-time checks. Toggle defaults on and survives reinjection; no external messages.
country_conquest: Current treasury and useful structures/levels/readiness/own missing production influence target utility. Weak manageable country elimination objective persists after first asset capture, bounded decisive allocation and reinforcement, reserves/counterattacks/time and spending limits retained; no reward guarantee.
missile_alerts: Observed non-self flights: estimated impact time, own or allied asset overlap using conservative radii, bounded land probes and coverage at target; up to 16 live alerts and 32 historic observations, up to 5Hz scan, visible dashboard warning; own threats feed existing SAM consideration. No guarantee of interception or available funds.
